narrative: Round 0 caught a real S5 merge-gate defeat (unconditional dismissal), and the agent fixed it well by gating on the recorded round-cap notice instead of re-deriving the cap. That gate trusted a body-content marker the codebase already documented as forgeable, so round 3 produced an S5 forgery finding (F15). Its fix in turn spawned round 4's literal-retype and doc-drift findings. Separately, the second bundle/action was never swept across every gate and doc line, so the 'covers only the first of two' gap resurfaced in rounds 1, 2 and 4 (F7/F9, F14, F19/F20). Rounds 3 and 4 were avoidable; the cap then left the last push unreviewed. Treat 2 as a floor.
guidance_observations: From round 2 on the agent stopped replying on threads and fixed silently. F14 went unaddressed and was re-raised as F20, and round-4 outcomes cannot be verified from the PR.

Each 'second surface' finding was fixed one site at a time, when one grep for root paths (`dist/`, `action.yml`, `README.md`) across CI, scripts and CLAUDE.md would have closed the whole class in round 0.
Burning to the 5-round cap meant the final commit 181002b merged unreviewed, a cost directly traceable to the F6→F15 chain.

narrative: Round 0 found a vacuous test left by an arity change, a stale union comment, an unvalidated-adjacent DEPENDENCY_DIFF overclaim, and several regressions from converging the workflow onto the installer template (dropped EXCLUDE_PATTERNS, transcript archive, uses: ./, an added duplicate-billing trigger). Round 1 ran on a push made before the round-0 fixes landed. It mostly re-raised the same findings, plus one new real boundary-validation gap (F11). Every finding was accepted, and the premises check out against the hunks. No finding was caused by an earlier fix.
guidance_observations: Pushing an unrelated fix (d08e721) before addressing the other round-0 threads bought a round that was mostly duplicates; batching all round-0 fixes into one push would have made round 1 review new code.
The template-convergence regressions (F2-F4, F7) all come from replacing a hand-tuned file with a template without diffing removed lines; that one check would have pre-empted half of round 0.
